en.name: Doomsayer
en.ability: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.
en.flavor: And on the Seventh Day, there shall be a great flood and a pestilence upon the People of the Village of the Ravens! The dead shall rise and the living shall repent! O Woe! O Unholy day! Only by great sacrifice shall they prevail! So sayeth the Sages of Nostros and so sayeth I.

revisions.v1: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.

zh.name: 末日预言者
zh.ability: 如果大于等于四名玩家存活，每名当前存活的玩家可以公开要求你杀死一名与他阵营相同的玩家（每名玩家限一次）。
